proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: condition (1) is known from the fibred-in-groupoids lemma; coverings of the base stack are exactly the fppf coverings pulled back along X -> S; descent for morphisms glues the compatible isomorphisms varphi_i by fpqc descent of quasi-coherent modules; descent for objects glues the descent datum (L_i, varphi_ij) to a unique invertible module L, ample by the descending-property lemma; the second assertion follows formally since the base is a stack over Sch_fppf (source lines 4091-4168)
